title: Exact degree-ten invariants of the ten-dimensional self-dual five-form: code, certificates and reproduction
description: Exact computational certificates supporting the degree-ten classification of local Lorentz invariants of a self-dual five-form in ten dimensions. Includes the tensor-side atlas and subspace incidence, the exact characteristic-zero closure certificate for the stress-flow reachable subspace, the exact modular Jacobian certificate with an explicit non-vanishing minor, the convention-controlled spinor-tensor bridge, and the common-sample comparison. The third-party spinor enumeration archive is NOT included; a manifest with per-file hashes and adapter instructions is provided instead.
